scenario: LSCP.3.2 -- a synchronous rule's `scope activation` fact has zero externally-observable lifetime: asserted and retracted within the tick, at the end of the RHS that asserted it (LSCP.2.4.1). `watch` is the instrument (LSCP.2.4.4 makes the fact matchable): it fires only if the Lock survives its activation, and it emits a ttl Seen so the count shows whether it did. Pin: fact_count 1 -- the Trig alone. 2 would be the Lock surviving (watch silent but the Lock live); 3 would be the watcher firing on it.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Lock scope activation:
    entity_id: String

schema Seen scope ttl 1_h:
    entity_id: String

rule gated:
    Trig t
->
    emit Lock entity_id: t.entity_id

rule watch:
    Lock l
->
    emit Seen entity_id: l.entity_id
